reviewer_mode: independent hostile AAA ground-arc-arrest and composite pre-Unity gate

scope.isolated_question: Whether the strongest Round010 evidence preserves Nyra identity, attached left yoke, copper route, right-hip capacitor, heavy right-leg engineering, one weapon, and same-hilt two-hand contact while removing samurai-adjacent tassets and historical odachi coding, creating a singular non-historical storm-shear silhouette, and expressing an ownable full-body Ground-Arc Arrest deceleration event driven through the entire body and equipment.
composite_pack: Round008 fresh-critic accepted combat-contact proof and promotion record
Round009 accepted and rejected mythic-force sheets, receipt, and fresh review
claims_not_made: 3D, rig, mesh, UV, deformation, collision, animation, LOD, engine, or production readiness
legal originality, exclusivity, copyright clearance, or trademark clearance

round010_candidates.fresh_finding: The left foot is flat, the hilt is low and nearly horizontal, and the broad base reads as a braced guard rather than a deceleration event.
Grip height and torso turn improve, but both feet carry the pose and the body remains balanced in a wide studio guard.

Strongest Round010 evidence: the trailing left heel lifts, the right grounding leg dominates, one complete non-historical slab weapon and same-hilt contact remain readable, and historical tassets are materially reduced. Even here, torso, scapulae, shoulders, elbows, wrists, cloth, plates, and conductor look arranged around a held blade rather than violently arrested by its momentum.
The left foot returns to flat support, the hilt stays low, and the frame regresses to a stable two-foot guard.

isolated_decision.finding: Candidate 03 is a meaningful silhouette correction and the strongest Round010 frame. It preserves the core Nyra equipment path, one weapon, and solved two-hand contact while replacing tassets and odachi curvature with an open-leg, broad-backed storm-shear read. It does not pass the isolated target: the giant slab weapon is non-historical but still familiar rather than singular, and the image reads as a carefully staged wide greatsword hold. The left toe pivot and compressed right leg suggest load, but blade mass does not visibly drive a continuous arrest through spine, scapulae, shoulders, elbows, wrists, pelvis, cloth, plates, and conductor.

private_benchmark_comparison.method: Six relevant full-body combat, costume, and weapon-force references were selected from a private visual inventory, randomly reordered, and placed in unlabeled two-panel sheets with independently randomized candidate side, aspect-preserving fit, neutral padding, and no retouching. Judgment was blind to side; all extraction and comparison material was destroyed after inspection.

comparisons.focus: layered costume hierarchy and authored material separation
comparisons.finding: The candidate's cobalt cloth, ivory protection, blackened engineering, copper route, and heavy right-leg hierarchy remain immediately legible across a complete figure.

comparisons.focus: action arc, threat response, and authored motion
comparisons.finding: The benchmark carries direction, timing, and risk through the whole figure; the candidate remains readable as a held end pose without a convincing prior arc or violent stop.
The candidate's equipment is coherent, but cloth, plates, yoke mount, hip capacitor, and conductor do not visibly react to a comparable impulse or directional load.
The complete pale-ground figure, split yoke, counter-diagonal weapon, and extreme heavy-right-leg asymmetry produce the faster isolated role read.

comparisons.focus: weapon acceleration and torso-to-arm force chain
comparisons.finding: The candidate's blade is clearer in outline, but the sternum-height grip, shoulders, scapulae, spine, and pelvis do not sell the claimed deceleration.

comparisons.focus: weapon mass and overhead load commitment
comparisons.finding: The oversized blade implies mass by scale, but the body and equipment do not carry equivalent compression, recoil, or counter-rotation.

categories.finding: The face, braid, left yoke, conductor, hip module, and heavy right leg survive, though the bare-arm action costume and several construction proportions drift from the accepted turnaround.
The accepted Round007 four-view authority remains clean and useful for modeling, with modest construction and orthographic drift.
The lifted left heel and loaded right knee improve support logic, but the wide pose, upright ribcage, quiet scapulae, and low arm line do not form a credible violent deceleration chain.
Nyra remains recognizable, but facial age, brow planes, eye treatment, and braid mass still shift across sheets.
Material classes remain clear, while the Round010 bare upper arm and simplified torso protection reduce the premium layered authority established in Round009.
The split yoke, counter-diagonal blade, open legs, and extreme grounding greave read fast; the giant slab-sword fighter silhouette remains familiar rather than singular.
Both complete hands occupy separated regions of one continuous grip with visible ingress, egress, compression, and plausible wrist alignment.
The complete base cage, guard, grip, blade, pommel, and tip are coherent, but the extreme blade-to-hilt ratio, balance, attachment loads, and absent bodily recoil undercut physical credibility.

Samurai-adjacent tassets and historical curvature are removed, but the oversized dark slab blade, bare muscular arm, exposed thigh rhythm, and heroic wide hold introduce familiar action-fantasy and franchise-adjacent cues.
The frame is polished and legible but only meets 2 of 6 blind comparisons; force specificity, reactive equipment behavior, and ownable weapon language remain below the hostile AAA bar.

composite_decision.finding: The complete pack preserves the identity/contact foundation and Round010 removes the strongest historical costume and weapon cues, but it fails the isolated event target, total score, category floor, and blinded benchmark gates.

single_biggest_remaining_visual_gap: A genuinely arrested, mechanically unified force chain: the current image still reads as a wide posed greatsword hold because blade momentum does not visibly load the spine, scapulae, shoulders, elbows, wrists, pelvis, feet, cloth, plates, and conductor as one violent deceleration event.

pre_unity_state.unityUnlockCondition: isolated target, total score, category floor, and 5-of-6 benchmark gate all pass in a fresh review
